summary: Georgia Forestry Commission lookout in Fannin County, registered 2017. Sources give its purpose but not its build year, builder or design.

events.note: Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register on August 23, 2017

evidence.supports: built to watch Piney Mountain and the surrounding country
evidence.quote: This tower was built to watch Piney Mountain and the surrounding area.

evidence.supports: administered by the Georgia Forestry Commission (agency)
tnlandforms lists 2,409 for the same coordinates, no unit stated

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives 2,396 ft (730 m); the tnlandforms list gives 2,409 with no unit stated and the same coordinates. The story uses the register figure. The record's elevation_m of 730.3 matches the register.

notes_for_editor: Only one substantive source (the NHLR register entry, which is short). No build year, builder, design, height, staffing or access found. Two WebSearch queries and one websearch.py query returned nothing about this tower in Georgia (Virginia Piney Mountain results were ignored). Fannin County history page checked: no lookout mention. Access level and staffing left unknown rather than guessed; do not climb until a source says otherwise.
